nom: STARFACE Star Strips + Salicylic Acid Pore-Clearing Nose Strips

avis.texte: I applied the nose strip onto my nose. The directions say to make sure you wet your nose with water before applying so that the strip can harden. After i pulled off the strip I could see all the clogged pores on the strip.

These are great for pulling all the tiny hairs out on my nose. Clearing my pores? Not so much. I can't tell when the product is the right dryness to remove. No matter how short or long I wait, it leaves a sticky film behind. I have to clean my nose again. They are also smaller in comparison to other nose strips I have tried.
I bought then for both me and my husband. It stays on well and gets the nasty out.
